purpose: A voice-first incident reporting assistant for frontline operations. The bot must clarify uncertain details and obtain confirmation before submitting a report.

fields.name: incident_id
fields.description: Generated unique ID; never ask the worker to invent one.

fields.name: reported_at
fields.description: Server timestamp; do not infer from speech if the system can record it.

fields.name: reporter_name_or_id
fields.description: Only collect if operationally needed; allow 'don't know'.

fields.name: site_name
fields.description: Site/project name.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Specific area, floor, road section, gate, machine bay, landmark or GPS-derived location if permitted.

fields.name: incident_type
fields.description: Best-fit category; preserve original wording in description.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Faithful concise summary; do not add unsupported facts.

fields.name: asset_or_equipment
fields.description: Machine/tool/vehicle name and asset ID if available.

fields.name: material
fields.description: Material name/type, grade or specification if stated.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Keep numeric value plus original spoken form when ambiguity matters.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: kg, bags, litres, metres, pieces, hours, etc.; never guess missing units.

fields.name: spoken_number_raw
fields.description: Original number phrase for audit when a number is normalized.

fields.name: date_or_time
fields.description: When it happened or when needed; clarify relative/ambiguous time.

fields.name: impact
fields.description: What is blocked, damaged, delayed or at risk.

fields.name: people_at_risk
fields.description: Who may be affected, if known; avoid collecting unnecessary personal data.

fields.name: urgency
fields.description: Use explicit risk rules; uncertainty must not silently downgrade an apparent emergency.

fields.name: immediate_action_taken
fields.description: Actions already taken; never instruct untrained workers to perform dangerous work.

fields.name: requested_action
fields.description: Repair, replenish, inspect, isolate, clean, investigate, etc.

fields.name: assigned_team
fields.description: Routing suggestion, subject to operational rules.

fields.name: missing_fields
fields.description: Required/important fields that remain unknown.

fields.name: uncertainties
fields.description: Field, competing interpretations, confidence and clarification question.

fields.name: conflicts
fields.description: Conflicting details stated by worker; retain both until clarified.

fields.name: source_language
fields.description: Detected/selected language, e.g. Hindi, English, Hinglish, Punjabi-influenced Hinglish.

fields.name: transcript
fields.description: Transcript, with uncertainty markers if needed.

fields.name: report_summary_spoken
fields.description: Human-readable read-back.

fields.name: reporter_confirmation
fields.description: Do not submit a normal work order as confirmed unless worker approves; emergency escalation follows separate safety policy.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Workflow state.

validation_rules: Never invent a location, quantity, unit, asset ID, date or cause.
Ask one focused clarification at a time; prioritize safety and routing blockers.
For emergency indicators, follow configured emergency escalation policy immediately; do not wait for perfect metadata.
If a number/ID has multiple plausible interpretations, read it back digit-by-digit or in the site's standard format.
Keep original transcript/raw number phrase when normalization could lose information.
A correction replaces a previous value only after the worker's intent is clear.
Do not submit a routine report until the read-back is confirmed.
Do not interpret filler words as a final answer when they signal continuation or uncertainty.
